ledger.claim: The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check trips on this driver's own trailing-30-day figures: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 5, which is 4 or more, and 5 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 40 is 0.125, which is greater than 0.08. Both limbs are met, so under POL-NS-07 the driver's compensation is WITHHELD and the case escalates under POL-NS-09 - and POL-NS-09(d) names precisely that anti-farming trip as an escalation trigger. The rider's SGD 4.50 was charged on 2026-07-31T07:28:41 and stands as CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so escalation is the only live route to the rider's money.

Where the anti-farming check trips, POL-NS-07 requires the escalation packet to DIRECT the human reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee in full. That direction is the remedy the rider seeks: 5 no-show terminations in 30 days against only 40 completed trips is the fee-farming pattern the check exists to catch, and the rider should not fund it.

Escalation here is mandatory, not discretionary, and it is terminal: POL-NS-09 applies where ANY of its triggers holds, and under POL-GEN-03 an ESCALATE ruling issues no monetary outcome and the disputed SGD 4.50 is held rather than resolved. NO_ACTION is the outcome the record does not support, because on a rider-filed dispute it would leave the charge exactly where it presently sits.

Nothing on the rider's own side engages POL-NS-09: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the 3-or-more threshold in limb (d), and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0, so limb (c)'s requirement of 2 or more no-show disputes between these same two parties is not met. The escalation this case requires is driven by the driver's termination pattern, and the rider raises no counter-pattern of his own.

The rider did not go silent, and the driver knew it: the driver's 'where are you' was read at 07:22:35, the rider answered 'coming down now' at 07:23:50, and the driver read that answer at 07:24:20, yet posted no reply within 120 seconds of it and placed no in-app call before cancelling at 07:28:24. POL-NS-04 limbs (a) and (b) are satisfied on that sequence. I do not overstate the point: limb (c) is not satisfied, because the rider's track sits 846 to 854 m from the pin against a 100 m STANDARD presence radius, so POL-NS-04 does not by itself exonerate the rider. The unanswered exchange remains the setting the reviewer must see when weighing the driver's termination history.

The trip record contains a driver 'arrived' event for TRP-03304 at 07:21:30, which satisfies limb (a) of POL-NS-01, and the record shows no boarding event at any point (started_at and ended_at are both null).

Limb (b) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on the POL-NS-02 test: the driver's trace shows 42 consecutive qualifying fixes inside the STANDARD pickup geofence in a single continuous run that begins at 07:21:30, exactly the arrived-event timestamp (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), and the driver's track never approaches closer to the pin than 0.111 m, far inside the 50 m arrival radius in force for this zone class.

Limb (c) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied: the driver held position inside that geofence for a continuous dwell of 410 seconds, from 07:21:30 to 07:28:20, against the free waiting period of 180 seconds carried in this trip's platform_policy — an excess of 230 seconds (derived shortfall_sec -230).

Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied: the trip was terminated by the driver at 07:28:24 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes that limb (d) recognises, and the cancellation falls 234 seconds after the required 180 second dwell had elapsed at 07:24:30.

The 'I'm Here' marker is not a false arrival under POL-NS-05: the first qualifying in-geofence fix falls at 07:21:30, the very second of the marker (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), so at the moment of marking the driver was already inside the arrival radius and was not more than 300 m away or travelling at 15 km/h or more; the marker is genuine, the waiting clock is not recomputed, and no false-arrival referral arises.

There is no waiting-period shortfall under POL-NS-06: the effective in-geofence dwell of 410 seconds exceeds the 180 second minimum in force, and the trace shows a single unbroken in-geofence interval (run_count 1), so no accumulation under limb (i) is required and no refund follows from this clause.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider: limb (c) affirmatively fails on admissible fixes, because the rider's own track places her device between 846.3 m and 854.2 m from the pickup pin across all 74 fixes, with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius for the majority (indeed for any part) of the waiting window; where limb (c) fails on admissible fixes the clause does not apply and the dispute is decided under POL-NS-01.

The chat log confirms that the rider had not reached the pickup: the driver wrote 'hi im at the pickup point, where are you' at 07:21:55 and the rider's only answer, at 07:23:50, was 'coming down now' (read 07:24:20), so she was still on her way down while the free waiting period ran out; the driver cancelled 274 seconds after that message and 234 seconds after the dwell requirement was met.

The wrong-entrance route of POL-NS-03 is not engaged: the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the 50 m POL-NS-02 arrival radius (nearest approach 0.111 m), not in the 50 m to 400 m band that clause governs, so no full refund and no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises on that footing and the fee is decided under POL-NS-01.

No artifact in this bundle is impaired under POL-NS-08 or POL-GEN-02: the trace carries 100% coverage at a 10 s cadence with no gaps and both tracks present, the chat log's msg_id sequence is intact with read receipts and matches the trip record's message count, and the fare breakdown's $4.50 cancellation-fee line reconciles exactly with the $4.50 figure in platform_policy — so no discount attaches to the driver's evidence.

The only sum in issue is the $4.50 cancellation fee, which the ledger shows as CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00 and routed to the driver; no waiting-time fee is chargeable or charged on this trip (waiting_time_fee 0.00), so POL-NS-10 has nothing to refund and the rider's claim reduces to the cancellation fee alone.

Because POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80% of the $4.50 net fee, $3.60 — the same figure the fare breakdown's own money block computes as driver_compensation — and the rider's charge is not refundable on this trip's evidence.

ledger.claim: I disclose against my own side that, on the correct fields, the POL-NS-07 anti-farming arithmetic meets both limbs of the test on the face of the record — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 5, at or above the threshold of 4, and 5 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 40 is 0.125, above 0.08 — so the clause withholds the driver's payout and routes the compensation question to POL-NS-09 rather than emitting DRIVER_COMPENSATION. I put this on the record rather than stretch the compensation claim; it is a trailing-window pattern test on the driver's account, not a finding about this trip, whose no-show is verified on the GPS, the chat log and the trip record.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: this case does not end in an automatic payment to either of you. It is ESCALATED to a human reviewer, and the disputed SGD 4.50 is held — not collected from the rider and not refunded — until that review is decided. Escalation is terminal and replaces any money ruling, including the driver's payout.

WHAT THE EVIDENCE ESTABLISHES. The no-show is verified on the record. The driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 07:21:30 and the GPS trace's first qualifying in-geofence fix falls at that same second (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, with the driver stationary — so the arrival marker is genuine, POL-NS-05 does not recompute the waiting clock, and no false-arrival referral arises. The driver then held position continuously for 410 seconds, to 07:28:20, against the 180-second free waiting period carried in this trip's platform_policy, and terminated at 07:28:24 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW — 234 seconds after the required dwell had elapsed at 07:24:30. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 therefore hold: (a) an arrived event; (b) GPS presence in the geofence at or before it; (c) a 410 s dwell against 180 s; (d) no boarding, and a driver termination under a recognised no-show code after the dwell elapsed. No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee: the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the 50 m radius, not in POL-NS-03's 50–400 m wrong-entrance band (nearest approach 0.111 m), and there is no waiting-period shortfall under POL-NS-06. The rider's own track sits between 846.3 m and 854.2 m from the pin across all 74 fixes, far outside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, so POL-NS-04 limb (c) fails affirmatively and that clause does not exonerate the rider.

WHY THE CASE ESCALATES RATHER THAN PAYING THE DRIVER. With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full, POL-NS-07 would fix the driver's payout at 80% of the SGD 4.50 net fee — SGD 3.60 — but only if its anti-farming check is clear. It is not. The check reads only the trailing-window fields the clause names: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 5, which is 4 or more, and 5 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 40 is 0.125, which is greater than 0.08. Both limbs trip. Under POL-NS-07 the driver's compensation is therefore WITHHELD and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d), which names precisely that anti-farming trip as a trigger. The lifetime counter driver_profile.prior_no_show_flags (9 on this record) is not the field this test reads and, per POL-GEN-01, is context only — it is used in neither direction here. Because escalation under POL-NS-09 is terminal, no monetary ruling issues, both money fields are null, and the disputed SGD 4.50 stays frozen.

REFERRAL. POL-NS-07 requires the escalation packet to direct the human reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee in full; that instruction is carried in the referrals list.

ON THE ADVOCATES' CLAIMS. The driver's case that the no-show is verified — the POL-NS-01 limbs (a) to (d), and the POL-NS-05, POL-NS-06, POL-NS-04(c), POL-NS-03 and POL-NS-10 points — is accepted on the facts and does not decide the outcome by itself. The driver's claim that POL-NS-07 pays SGD 3.60 and that the charge is 'not refundable on this trip's evidence' is outweighed by the driver's own accurate disclosure — matched by the rider's claim — that the same clause's anti-farming arithmetic trips on 5 and 40; where that check trips POL-NS-07 withholds the payout and routes the fee to POL-NS-09, so no DRIVER_COMPENSATION issues. The rider's claims that escalation is mandatory and terminal, and that nothing on his own profile engages POL-NS-09 (no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the 3-or-more threshold; disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both sides), are accepted. The rider's POL-NS-04 point — limbs (a) and (b) met, limb (c) failed — is accepted and changes nothing: the driver's arrival and dwell stand on the GPS trace and trip record independently of it.

CONFIDENCE AND WEIGHT. Every artifact this ruling rests on — the trip record, GPS trace, chat log, fare ledger and driver profile — carries weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. The only artifact below 1.0 is the missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-03304-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT); it carries no fact this ruling needs — no accumulation of separate in-geofence intervals is required and no advocate asserted it — so it neither caps nor discounts the finding, and it need not be narrated further. Confidence is 0.95, above the 0.70 floor; the escalation here is driven by POL-NS-09(d), not by low confidence.

OPEN QUESTION FOR THE REVIEWER. Whether this driver's five no-show terminations in the last 30 days against only 40 completed trips is the fee-farming pattern POL-NS-07's guard exists to catch, so that the rider's SGD 4.50 is refunded in full as the packet directs, or an ordinary work pattern on which the withheld compensation should be released instead. The monetary effect of either outcome (SGD 4.50) sits below the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so the reviewer can release the held amount directly once decided.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
referrals: POL-NS-07: direct the human reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 in full — the anti-farming check on this driver has tripped, so the driver's compensation is withheld and the escalation packet must instruct the reviewer to make the rider whole.
